booking.intro: Let people book paid 1:1 video sessions with you. Set your availability and price, then turn on Bookable to become bookable from your profile link.
booking.noAvailability: No availability yet — add a recurring weekly window below.
booking.noPriceRules: Base price applies to every available slot.
booking.cancellationCopy: Bookers receive a full refund when they cancel at least 24 hours before the session starts. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the session are non-refundable. If you (the host) cancel or do not attend, the booker receives a full refund.
booking.publishBlockedNote: Set up your app wallet to receive payouts.
booking.publishLiveNote: Anyone with your profile link can book an available slot.
booking.publishReadyNote: You're ready — publish to let people book you.
booking.navDescription: Set your paid 1:1 schedule, pricing, and availability.
booking.bookableOnHint: People can book you. Turn off to pause without losing your schedule.
booking.bookableOffHint: You're not bookable yet — turn on when you're ready.
booking.bookableNoAvailability: Bookable is on, but you're not visible yet — add weekly availability below to appear in search and feed.

rules.reportingDescription: Users or mods can select a report reason when reporting content.
rules.reportReasonHint: By default, this is the same as your rule name.
rules.defaultRule1Body: No harassment, hate speech, or toxic behavior. Treat all contributors and members with kindness.
rules.defaultRule2Body: Excessive promotion, spam, or advertising of any kind is not allowed.
